worktree: source: src/dsa/gen.rs, src/dsa/sign.rs, src/dso/dlfcn.rs; ledger: REMAINING-AUDIT.txt, AUDITED-FILES.txt, PERFILE-INDEX.md section 53 and this file.
scope: The eight files named as next by M47: src/dsa/ctrl.rs, src/dsa/depr.rs, src/dsa/gen.rs, src/dsa/key.rs, src/dsa/prn.rs, src/dsa/sign.rs, src/dsa/vrf.rs, src/dso/dlfcn.rs. Five audited with no source change. Repairs: a negative seed_len no longer generates parameters (D1); i2d_DSA_SIG's encoder error path releases its BUF_MEM before WPACKET_cleanup as dsa_sign.c does (D2); DSA_SIG_set0's contract requires distinct exclusively-owned halves (D3); dlfcn_pathbyaddr's contract permits a NULL path only for the sizing call (D4). No new production unsafe operation, FFI symbol, allocator coordinate, repr(C) layout, exported signature or unsafe lint attribute.

mechanisms: six OSSL_PARAM builders through non-strict EVP_PKEY_CTX_set_params
file_dispositions.note: crypto/evp/dsa_ctrl.c. The authority's pmeth key-type arm is unreachable because this crate's EvpPkeyCtx has no pmeth, so its -1 branch is never taken; the NULL/non-generation arm answers -2 with EVP_R_COMMAND_NOT_SUPPORTED. Every builder's contract covers a NULL-or-live context, NUL-terminated strings, a seed readable for seedlen, and locals outliving the set-params call. The seven NULL-context answers are pinned by dsa::ctrl::tests. No change.

crypto/dsa/dsa_depr.c. DSA_new then BN_GENCB_new (failure frees the DSA), BN_GENCB_set_old, then DSA_generate_parameters_ex. Success returns the DSA and frees the callback; failure frees the callback then the DSA, preserving the authority's cb-first order on both paths. The callback is the caller's and is invoked through BN_GENCB under the B-series contract; no Rust borrow is held. No change.

crypto/dsa/dsa_gen.c. M48-D1 (low, compatibility): seed_len.max(0) clamped a negative int to zero, which cleared/omitted the seed and then generated parameters, answering 1. The authority converts the int to size_t, putting the length at or above INT_MAX, which CRYPTO_memdup refuses, so it answers 0. An explicit negative refusal now precedes set_validate_params; the authority's invalid-input state artifact (pre-existing seed dropped, seedlen left stale) is documented as not reproduced. A regression test pins the refusal. The 186-2/186-4 selector and dirty_cnt arm are unchanged.

mechanisms: DSA_generate_key method dispatch and static dsa_keygen
file_dispositions.note: crypto/dsa/dsa_key.c. The scratch is BN_clear_free'd on both exits; this crate's BN_with_flags copies limbs, so it owns its storage. The fresh private exponent is BN_secure_new, so the authority's plain BN_free on the failure path is secret-safe through B19's BN_FLG_SECURE cleansing arm. The pub_key != dsa->pub_key / priv_key != dsa->priv_key comparisons keep a caller's existing keys out of the release. FIPS-only pairwise/KATs are not compiled, as in the profile. No change.

crypto/dsa/dsa_prn.c. Both FILE wrappers build a BIO_s_file, install the caller's FILE with BIO_NOCLOSE, print, and free the BIO on every path; both BIO printers build a throwaway EVP_PKEY, gate the print on EVP_PKEY_set1_DSA, and free it on every path. Private-key printing is the API's purpose; the unit keeps no internal secret buffer. No change.

mechanisms: OwnedSig CRYPTO_zalloc owner and BN_clear_free Drop
DSA_size, ossl_dsa_sign_int, DSA_sign, DSA_verify canonical re-encode
file_dispositions.note: crypto/dsa/dsa_sign.c. M48-D2 (low, compatibility): the encoder failure path dropped the BUF_MEM at scope exit after WPACKET_cleanup, while dsa_sign.c:106-108 frees the buffer before cleaning sub-packets; a recording allocator observes that order. The repair drops buf explicitly before cleanup, and WPACKET_cleanup only walks pkt.subs so the order is also sound. M48-D3 (low, contract): DSA_SIG_set0 now requires distinct, exclusively owned r/s, because a repeated pointer was permitted by the old text but would double-release through OwnedSig::Drop. The DER re-encode is cleansed over derlen.max(0) bytes; both halves are BN_clear_free'd.

crypto/dsa/dsa_vrf.c. One dispatch to dsa->meth->dsa_do_verify. The authority calls the member unconditionally; this crate's nullable table entry is the reduction, and an absent member answers -1, the authority's 'not verified for a reason other than a wrong signature'. The dgst/sig/dsa contracts are the authority's. No change.

mechanisms: dlfcn_load errno save/restore and filename ownership
dlfcn_unload push-back on a NULL handle
static DSO_METHOD table and guard_ffi export
file_dispositions.note: crypto/dso/dso_dlfcn.c. M48-D4 (low, contract): the dlfcn_pathbyaddr # Safety text allowed a NULL path unconditionally, but the body writes path[len] when sz > 0; it now permits NULL only for the sizing call. The loader edge was audited: dlopen/dlsym/dlclose invoke no application callback while a Rust borrow is held (library constructors run inside dlopen with no Rust object borrowed; the converted name is an owned OwnedStr). dlfcn_load's push-failure path frees the name before dlclose, matching the authority's err: label. The method table's NULL ctrl/init/finish remain load-bearing.

safety_contract_repairs.repair: Refuse a negative seed_len before set_validate_params instead of clamping it to zero. The authority's int-to-size_t conversion makes the length >= INT_MAX, which CRYPTO_memdup refuses, so DSA_generate_parameters_ex answers 0; the clamp instead omitted the seed and answered 1 after generation.
Drop the BUF_MEM before WPACKET_cleanup on i2d_DSA_SIG's encoder failure path, matching dsa_sign.c:106-108's free-then-cleanup order; WPACKET_cleanup only walks pkt.subs, so no double release.
safety_contract_repairs.control: full library suite; dso/dsa focused filters

safety_contract_repairs.repair: DSA_SIG_set0's # Safety now requires each non-NULL r/s to be distinct and exclusively owned; the previous text admitted the same pointer twice, which OwnedSig::Drop would release twice.
dlfcn_pathbyaddr's # Safety now permits a NULL path only when sz <= 0, because the sz > 0 arm writes path[len] with no NULL test.

reconciliation.method: AUDITED-FILES.txt is the union of each mechanism sweep's structured .files array, the M1 files, the structured per-file records and each boundary sweep's structured boundaries. The eight audited files were removed from the head of REMAINING-AUDIT.txt and merged in LC_ALL=C order into AUDITED-FILES.txt.
reconciliation.difference_from_423: M48 moves exactly the eight named ordinary files; no file is skipped or substituted.

retained_observations: M48-D1's refused negative-seed path leaves a pre-existing FFC seed (and its stale seedlen) in place; the authority clears both as a side effect of routing the invalid length through CRYPTO_memdup. The return value (0) is preserved, and the state difference is confined to an input the header's length contract excludes.

DSA_do_sign and DSA_do_verify dereference dsa->meth without a NULL test, as the authority does. A live Dsa built by this crate always carries the non-null default table; DSA_set_method's contract is the caller's obligation. gen.rs/key.rs additionally test the nullable member because the authority's own clauses read it.

The added unsafe operation is the test-only block in dsa::gen::tests; it carries an explicit SAFETY comment. No production unsafe operation was introduced, and no CRYPTO_* seam coordinate, repr(C) layout, export or lint attribute changed.

The DSO loader edge was audited for reentrancy: dlopen may run a library's constructors, but no Rust borrow or lock is held across it, so the task's 'application callback under a Rust borrow' condition does not arise. A dedicated loader BOUNDARY pass remains available if the trust boundary changes.
